name: @waf-harness/awm-rsi-toolkit
description: The AWM RSI Toolkit: Agent Workflow Memory (Wang et al., 2024, https://arxiv.org/abs/2409.07429) — workflows are induced from successful trajectories and stored in the Target's memory, online over a training stream or offline from supplied experiences, then frozen for independent testing on the Benchmark. Self-contained: it creates the Target's workflow memory, evaluates its own cells and writes the Evaluation Center's scoreboard.

wafh.short_description: AWM RSI Toolkit: induce workflows from trajectories.

quick_start.prompt: Use the `awm-rsi-toolkit` Skill to run AWM on an agent of this Project: ask me for the Test Agent and the published Benchmark, run the online_train mode over its cases once at the smoke budget, freeze the workflow memory, and report the baseline and final scores.

wafh.title: AWM RSI Toolkit
